summary.oneLiner: An integrated iron and steel manufacturing company specializing in customized engineering solutions, which according to CRISIL is one of India's largest metal rolls producers, meeting 10.00-11.5% of the country's demand in Fiscal 2026.
summary.business: Behari Lal Engineering manufactures precision engineered components for critical industrial applications - metal rolls for rolling mills, engineering castings (500 kg to 20 MT per unit), carbon/alloy/stainless steel bars (6 mm to 230 mm), and forging ingots and forged shafts/blocks (500 kg to 15 tons). It operates 2 integrated divisions in Mandi Gobindgarh, Punjab - a Steel Melting Shop (SMS) and Foundry Division and a Rolling Mill Division - with a digital melting shop, ladle refining furnace, vacuum degassing, foundry, heat treatment, machine shops and rolling mills.
